parameters.command:
sqlite3 -json /data/arabic_dict.db "
SELECT e.id AS entry_id, e.dictionary_id,
       e.headword, e.headword_bare, e.headword_norm,
       e.definitions_text, e.translation_en, e.domain,
       d.name_en, d.source_type
FROM entries e
JOIN dictionaries d ON e.dictionary_id = d.id
WHERE e.headword_norm IN ('فوق شعبة', 'الفوق شعبة', 'فوق الشعبة')
   OR e.headword_norm IN ('شعيبة', 'الشعيبة')
ORDER BY e.headword_norm, d.source_type;
"

sqlite3 -json /data/arabic_dict.db "
SELECT e.id AS entry_id, e.dictionary_id,
       e.headword, e.headword_bare, e.headword_norm,
       e.definitions_text, e.translation_en, e.domain,
       d.name_en, d.source_type
FROM entries e
JOIN dictionaries d ON e.dictionary_id = d.id
WHERE e.id IN (
    SELECT rowid FROM entries_translations_fts
    WHERE entries_translations_fts MATCH 'translation_en:\"superphylum\"'
)
ORDER BY d.source_type;
"
